objective: Agent runs the mr-review phases as SKILL.md prescribes; this file starts with the D8 naming dimension. Local mode: one review_changes call with `changes` (base = target branch, read at its merge-base with HEAD) and sections ["naming"] reviews every name the diff's added hunks declare, findings grouped by verdict. External mode (MR branch not checked out): names[] built from the diff's added lines. MISFIT / NEW_TERM / COLLISION surface as findings with the suggestion, holder or existing declaration as evidence. Cases with status 'superseded' are kept as history and not scored.

cases.context: Prime `## Enrichment` lists codegraph.symbols (get_naming_lexicon is available). Local review; the diff adds `row = find_vendor_envelope(id)` in app/services/tax_automation/importer.rb, returning a TaxAutomationDocument.

mustDo: Run D8 as ONE review_changes(changes: { base: <target branch, e.g. main> }, sections: ["naming"]) call (project alias + path) — it judges every name the added hunks declare (row, find_vendor_envelope)
Turn MISFIT (and NEW_TERM only when alternatives/topTerms name the same concept) into a [minor] finding whose fix is the returned suggestion, citing the holder file as precedent
Word the comment body in plain language (no MISFIT / lexicon / tool names)
mustNotDo: Hand-list the diff's identifiers into get_naming_lexicon names[] in local mode, or pass the removed get_naming_lexicon `changes` param
Judge the names by taste or by grep / semantic_search on the draft name
Report naming as 'not assessed' while codegraph is on

cases.failureMode: Agent skips the naming dimension or flags names without project evidence
cases.reason: get_naming_lexicon reviews a diff itself through `changes` (bd tea-rags-mcp-fdef2); hand-listing the diff's identifiers into names[] stays only for external mode, where the MR branch is not in the working tree. Since then diff naming moved to review_changes sections:[naming] (get_naming_lexicon rejects `changes`). Expectation re-aligned to the current contract on 2026-10-23 so a run that scores it anyway tests current behaviour.

cases.context: Prime `## Enrichment` lists codegraph.symbols (get_naming_lexicon is available). Local review on branch feature/envelope-sync; the diff adds `row = find_vendor_envelope(id)` and a new class `Commit` in app/services/tax_automation/importer.rb. The review call returns MISFIT for row (suggestion tax_automation_document, holder app/services/tax_automation/loader.rb), NEW_TERM for find_vendor_envelope, COLLISION for Commit (existing app/models/commit.rb), 14 conforming.

mustDo: Run D8 as ONE review_changes call with `changes: { base: <target branch, e.g. main> }` and sections: ["naming"] (the tool reads base at its merge-base with HEAD) (project alias + path), no hand-built names[]

Report the naming findings grouped by verdict (MISFIT, COLLISION, NEW_TERM) with relPath:line from review.findings, and the review.conforming / review.novel counts as one summary line (a count the review answer does not give → n/a, never invented)
MISFIT → minor finding whose fix is the suggestion with the holder as precedent; COLLISION → finding naming the existing declaration's file
Word comment bodies in plain language (no verdict codes, no tool names)
mustNotDo: List the diff's identifiers by hand into names[] in local mode
Call get_naming_lexicon with `changes` (removed param — the tool rejects it)
Judge the names by taste or by grep / semantic_search on the draft name
Turn a NEW_TERM that carries no alternatives into a rename demand

cases.failureMode: Agent re-lists names by hand (misses types and constants) or reports raw verdicts instead of grouped, evidenced findings
